problem: The full tests/runtime_rc2 suite has become an integration and release-checkpoint battery, costing too much time and data for every small patch.
strategy: Use tiered validation: py_compile and focused tests for edits, rc2_fast_validate.py for inner-loop smoke, and full tests/runtime_rc2 only before commit/push or release checkpoints.

tier_1_focused_tests.when: After changing one module or one small subsystem.

tier_2_fast_smoke.when: Default RC2 inner-loop validation and before staging.

tier_3_full_rc2.when: Only for final pre-push, release checkpoint, or broad subsystem changes.

expected_time_data_savings.old_inner_loop: Full tests/runtime_rc2 after every patch, observed around 20 minutes and high data use.
expected_time_data_savings.new_inner_loop: Compile plus focused tests plus scripts/rc2_fast_validate.py.
expected_time_data_savings.expected_result: Most small RC2 patches should avoid full runtime_rc2 until final validation.

policy.future_marathon_default: Do not run full runtime_rc2 until final validation.
